manifest.name: dsh-model-picker
manifest.description: 模型速选器（Model Quick Picker）：在会话窗口右下角模型下拉的左侧添加一个小按钮，点击弹出全量模型选择窗口（提供商分组、搜索、提供商筛选、真实 input 能力标签、推理徽章、当前选中高亮），选择后实时回写模型下拉框并立即生效。

bundle.text:
# dsh-model-picker bundle patch.
#
# 一行 insert 即挂载 Host 半身（no-op，见 index.js）；浏览器半身由
# package.json 的 dsh.client 声明，并绑定在 name 为裸包名的这一行上。
- insert:
    - id: dsh-model-picker
      name: 'dsh-model-picker'
      config: {}

readme.section: dsh-model-picker · 模型速选器（DeepSeek Harness 插件）
readme.text:
[简体中文](README.md) | [English](README.en.md)

在 DeepSeek Harness 会话窗口右下角 **模型下拉框的左侧** 添加一个小按钮。
点击按钮弹出全量模型选择窗口：按提供商分组、实时搜索、提供商筛选、
真实能力标签、推理徽章、当前选中高亮，加载 / 失败 / 会话占用等状态都有清晰呈现。
**选择模型后立即回写模型下拉框并生效** —— 因为它与原生下拉框共用同一条
per-session 模型目录与 `selectModel` 提交路径（"任一端切换，另一端立刻显示"）。

- **触发按钮**：28px 圆形图标按钮，紧贴模型下拉左侧，与 composer 工具栏
  「+」按钮同风格（悬停 / 焦点环 / 禁用态齐全）。
- **选择窗口**（居中弹窗，主题变量配色，深浅色主题自适应）：
  - **头部**：标题 + 提供商/模型计数 + 关闭；
  - **最近使用**：打开即见上次用过的模型（最多 8 个，自动记录、本地持久化），
    每行显示 **`提供商 · 模型`**（如 `火山方舟 · deepseek-v4-flash-ga`），
    点一下即切回常用模型；
  - **提供商筛选**：搜索框左侧的自定义下拉（全部提供商 / 单个提供商），
    跟随主题渲染（不用原生 `<select>`，避免深色主题下系统面板惨白）；
  - **搜索**：模型名 / 模型 id / 提供商名模糊匹配，↑↓ 移动高亮、Enter 选中、Esc 关闭；
  - **列表**：按提供商分组（DeepSeek 账号 / 官方优先），分组带色条与计数徽章，
    每行显示 **完整模型名** + **能力标签** + 「推理」徽章 + 「当前」徽章 + 选中勾，
    大列表按需懒渲染（滚动才加载，打开更快）；
  - **底部**：当前模型摘要 + **推理档位（reasoning effort）选择器** + 关闭按钮；
  - **状态**：加载中（spinner）、加载失败（重试）、提供商加载失败（逐条提示）、
    当前模型已不可路由（警告）、会话被占用（专用文案）。

行内的 `📝 文本` / `🖼️ 图像` 标签**不是**从模型描述文字里猜的，而是读
**用户自己配置里声明的 `input` 列表**（pi-ai 提供商配置，如
`providers.<id>.models[].input: [text, image]`）。实现走 DSH 已有的
`settings` Remote 读取 settings 文档，扫描各命名空间的 `providers → models[].input`
建索引；配置里没写 `input` 的提供商就不显示标签（如实反映配置，不做臆测）。
增删配置里的 `input`，标签随之变化。

> **契约说明（已验证）**：能力标签用 `group.id` 查询索引，而 `group.id` 与
> settings 中 `providers` 的**配置 key 同命名空间**（DSH 的 modelCatalog 以
> `provider.id` 作为分组 id、`provider.name` 作为显示名）。因此
> `providers.volcengine-agent-plan` 这类配置 key 能被可靠匹配；若未来 DSH
> 改变这一命名约定，标签会安静地不显示（不会报错），插件其余功能不受影响。

> **为什么只能从配置读（已验证）**：浏览器侧拿到的 `modelCatalog` RPC 返回的
> 模型对象**只有 `id` / `name` / `description` / `reasoning`，不含 `input`** ——
> DSH 的 Host 侧在构建浏览器目录时把 `input` 字段投影丢弃了（见
> `buildModelCatalog`）。因此插件无法从模型目录兜底读取能力，配置是浏览器侧
> 唯一的 `input` 来源。想给某个模型显示能力标签，就在 pi-ai 提供商配置里为它
> 写 `input`：
>
> ```yaml
> # profile 的 cordis.patch.yml，llm-pi-ai 提供商配置内
> models:
>   - id: deepseek-v4-flash-ga-260731
>     input: [text, image]   # 声明后插件即显示「文本 / 图像」标签
>
> 这也解释了为什么**同一个模型 id 在不同用户那里标签可能不同**——它如实反映
> 各自配置，而非模型本身的客观能力。

1. 注册进 composer 的 **`conversation.input.right`** slot —— 这是一个
   `kind: list`、`scope: session` 的官方扩展点，composer 栏在渲染模型
   seat（`conversation.input.model`）之前渲染它，因此按钮天然出现在
   模型下拉的**左边**。
2. 通过 `ctx.inject(['slots', 'modelDirectories'], …)` 拿到
   `ctx.modelDirectories`（由 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-model-selection`
   注册的共享服务），对当前会话解析出与原生下拉**同一个**
   `ModelDirectory` 实例。
3. 弹窗里选择模型 → `directory.select({ provider, model, reasoningEffort })`
   → 走与原生下拉完全相同的 `selectModel` RPC。成功后共享 store 更新，
   原生模型下拉的标签**自动回写**，会话模型切换立即生效。
4. 能力标签由 `ctx.inject(['…', 'remote', 'remote.settings'])` 注入的
   `settings` Remote 读取：`settings.describe()` 返回各命名空间的合并配置，
   从中提取 `provider → model → input[]`。注意 **`remote.<namespace>` 必须显式
   写进 inject 列表**（cordis 规则），只注入根 `remote` 会在访问时报
   `cannot get property "remote.settings" without inject`。
5. 子代理（subagent addressed）会话没有模型目录，按钮自动隐藏。
支持 **web 与 desktop** 两个 profile（`platform: web` 的插件在两者中均生效）。

readme.section: 方式 A：git clone 后本地安装（推荐）
readme.text:
```sh
git clone https://github.com/faxble/dsh-model-picker.git
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-model-picker
```

把 `/path/to/dsh-model-picker` 换成实际 clone 路径；桌面版把 `web` 换成
`desktop`：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add /path/to/dsh-model-picker
```

安装后重启 DeepSeek Harness，在「设置 → 插件」中启用 `dsh-model-picker`，
或确认它已自动启用。

readme.section: 方式 B：远程直接安装（免 clone）
readme.text:
```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:faxble/dsh-model-picker
```

readme.section: 方式 C：手动加入 profile（开发者调试用）
readme.text:
1. 在 profile（默认 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop`）的 `package.json` 中：
   - `dependencies` 增加 `"dsh-model-picker": "file:D:\\Dev\\VibeCoding\\dsh-model-picker"`；
   - `dsh.profile.bundles` 增加 `"dsh-model-picker"`。
2. 在 profile 目录执行 `pnpm install`。
3. 重启 DeepSeek Harness。

```
dsh-model-picker/
├── package.json        # 包元数据 + dsh.client 声明（platform: web）
├── index.js            # Host 半身（no-op，仅承载 bundle 行）
├── cordis.patch.yml    # bundle patch：一行 insert（name 为裸包名）

- 纯前端插件：**运行时无构建、无运行时依赖**（只用 shell 已提供的 `react`），
  全部颜色来自 DSH 主题 CSS 变量，切换深浅色主题无需重载。
  `client.js` 是构建产物，开发期用 `pnpm build` 从 `src/` 生成。
- 不修改任何 DSH 核心代码；`conversation.input.right` 目前没有任何占用者，
  注册不会遮蔽既有 UI。
- 界面文案**中英双语**，随 DSH 系统语言自动切换（zh / en），外国用户可直接使用。
- 附加功能：**最近使用（MRU）置顶**、**搜索打分排序**（精确 > 前缀 > 包含）、
  **推理档位（reasoning effort）选择器**、大列表**懒渲染**、焦点陷阱等无障碍支持。
  - 最近使用行显示 **`提供商 · 模型`**（如 `火山方舟 · deepseek-v4-flash-ga`），
    提供商名在模型左侧、本地化并浅灰次要显示，跨提供商时避免同名模型混淆。
- 主题取值注意：**不要用 `--dsw-alias-brand-text` 做选中行文字色** ——
  它的语义是"品牌色块**上**的文字"（浅色主题设计值），深色主题下解析为深色，
  配软高亮底会变成黑字看不清；文字统一用 `--dsw-alias-label-primary`。

- 改 `src/` 后执行 `pnpm build` 重新生成 `client.js`，再复制到 profile 触发
  HMR 热更新（页面无需刷新，DSH 会检测到文件变更并重新加载 bundle）：

```powershell
  pnpm build
  Copy-Item .\client.js $env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\desktop\node_modules\dsh-model-picker\client.js -Force
  ```

- 单元测试：`pnpm test`（`node --test`，覆盖 `src/pure.js` 的纯逻辑）。
- 构建校验：`pnpm check`（`node --check` 产物）。**CI 会校验 `client.js` 是否为
  最新构建**，改了 `src/` 忘了 build 会让 CI 失败。
- 若要源码改动即时生效（免复制），改用 `link:` 符号链接方式安装。
- 移除插件：DSH「设置 → 插件」里卸载 `dsh-model-picker` 即可。

readme.section: dsh-model-picker · Model Quick Picker (DeepSeek Harness plugin)
readme.text:
Adds a small button to the **left of the model dropdown** in the bottom-right of a
DeepSeek Harness session window. Clicking it opens a full model-selection popover:
grouped by provider, with live search, provider filtering, real capability tags,
reasoning badges and highlight of the currently selected model — loading, failure
and session-occupied states are all clearly presented.
**The selection writes back to the native model dropdown and takes effect
immediately**, because it shares the exact same per-session model directory and
`selectModel` submission path as the native dropdown ("switch on either side,
the other updates instantly").

- **Trigger button**: 28px circular icon button, placed flush to the left of the
  model dropdown, styled like the "＋" button in the composer toolbar (hover /
  focus ring / disabled states all included).
- **Selection window** (centered modal, themed with CSS variables, adapts to
  light/dark themes):
  - **Header**: title + provider/model count + close;
  - **Recently used**: models you picked before (up to 8, auto-recorded,
    persisted locally), each row showing **`provider · model`** (e.g.
    `Volcengine · deepseek-v4-flash-ga`) — one click switches back;
  - **Provider filter**: custom dropdown to the left of the search box (all
    providers / a single provider), rendered with theme colors (no native
    `<select>`, avoiding a glaring system panel under dark themes);
  - **Search**: fuzzy match on model name / model id / provider name, ↑↓ to move
    the highlight, Enter to select, Esc to close;
  - **List**: grouped by provider (DeepSeek account / official first), groups with
    a color bar and a count badge; each row shows the **full model name** +
    **capability tags** + a "reasoning" badge + a "current" badge + a selection check;
    large lists render lazily on scr

The inline `📝 text` / `🖼️ image` tags are **not** guessed from model description
text — they are read from the `input` lists **declared in the user's own config**
(pi-ai provider config, e.g. `providers.<id>.models[].input: [text, image]`).
The implementation reads the settings document through DSH's existing `settings`
Remote and scans `providers → models[].input` across namespaces to build an index;
providers without an `input` field in config show no tags (an honest reflection of
config, no guessing). Add or remove `input` in config and the tags update
accordingly.

> **Contract note (verified)**: tags are looked up by `group.id`, which shares a
> namespace with the **provider config keys** in settings (DSH's modelCatalog uses
> `provider.id` as the group id and `provider.name` as the display name). So a
> config key like `providers.volcengine-agent-plan` is matched reliably; should a
> future DSH change this naming contract, the tags silently disappear (no error)
> while the rest of the plugin keeps working.

> **Why config is the only source (verified)**: the model objects returned by the
> browser-side `modelCatalog` RPC carry **only `id` / `name` / `description` /
> `reasoning` — no `input`**: DSH's Host side drops the `input` field when it
> projects the browser catalog (see `buildModelCatalog`). So the plugin cannot
> fall back to the model directory for capabilities; config is the only
> browser-visible `input` source. To show capability tags for a model, declare
> `input` for it in the pi-ai provider config:
>
> ```yaml
> # inside your profile's cordis.patch.yml, under the llm-pi-ai provider config
> models:
>   - id: deepseek-v4-flash-ga-260731
>     input: [text, image]   # once declared, the plugin shows the text/image tags
>
> This also explains why the **same model id can show different tags for
> different users** — the tags honestly reflect each user's own config, not the
> model's objective capabilities.

1. Registers into the **`conversation.input.right`** slot of the composer — an
   official extension point with `kind: list`, `scope: session`. The composer bar
   renders this slot before the model seat (`conversation.input.model`), so the
   button naturally appears to the **left** of the model dropdown.
2. `ctx.inject(['slots', 'modelDirectories'], …)` provides
   `ctx.modelDirectories` (the shared service registered by
   `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-model-selection`), resolving to the **same**
   `ModelDirectory` instance the native dropdown uses for the current session.
3. Selecting a model in the popover calls
   `directory.select({ provider, model, reasoningEffort })` → the exact same
   `selectModel` RPC as the native dropdown. On success the shared store updates,
   the native dropdown label **writes back automatically** and the session model
   switch takes effect immediately.
4. Capability tags are read via the `settings` Remote injected by
   `ctx.inject(['…', 'remote', 'remote.settings'])`:
   `settings.describe()` returns the merged config across namespaces, from which
   `provider → model → input[]` is extracted. Note that **`remote.<namespace>`
   must be explicitly

Works with both the **web and desktop** profiles (a `platform: web` plugin takes
effect in both).

readme.section: Method A: git clone, then install locally (recommended)
readme.text:
```sh
git clone https://github.com/faxble/dsh-model-picker.git
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-model-picker
```

Replace `/path/to/dsh-model-picker` with your actual clone path; for the desktop
app, just swap `web` for `desktop`:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add /path/to/dsh-model-picker
```

After installing, restart DeepSeek Harness and enable `dsh-model-picker` under
Settings → Plugins, or confirm it was auto-enabled.

readme.section: Method B: Install directly from GitHub (no clone)
readme.text:
```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:faxble/dsh-model-picker
```

readme.section: Method C: Add manually to the profile (developer/debug use)
readme.text:
1. In the profile (default `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop`) `package.json`:
   - add `"dsh-model-picker": "file:D:\\Dev\\VibeCoding\\dsh-model-picker"` to
     `dependencies`;
   - add `"dsh-model-picker"` to `dsh.profile.bundles`.
2. Run `pnpm install` in the profile directory.
3. Restart DeepSeek Harness.

```
dsh-model-picker/
├── package.json        # package metadata + dsh.client declaration (platform: web)
├── index.js            # host half (no-op, just carries the bundle line)
├── cordis.patch.yml    # bundle patch: a one-line insert (name is the bare package name)

- Pure frontend plugin: **no runtime build step, no runtime dependencies** (only
  the `react` already provided by the shell); all colors come from DSH theme CSS
  variables, and switching light/dark themes needs no reload. `client.js` is a
  build artifact generated from `src/` via `pnpm build`.
- Modifies no DSH core code; `conversation.input.right` currently has no other
  consumers, so registering it shadows nothing.
- UI copy is **bilingual (zh / en)** and follows the DSH system language
  automatically — non-Chinese users can use it as-is.
- Extras: **recently-used (MRU) section pinned on top**, **ranked search**
  (exact > prefix > substring), a **reasoning-effort picker**, **lazy rendering**
  for large model lists, and accessibility support (focus trap, focus restore,
  aria-live, keyboard navigation).
  - Each recently-used row reads **`provider · model`** (e.g.
    `Volcengine · deepseek-v4-flash-ga`); the provider is shown on the LEFT of the
    model name, localized and dimmed, so the same model id under different
    providers is never ambiguous.
- Theme note: **do not use `--dsw-alias-brand-text` for selected-row text color**
  — its semantics is "text **on** the bra

- After editing `src/`, run `pnpm build` to regenerate `client.js`, then copy it
  into the profile to trigger an HMR hot reload (no page refresh needed — DSH
  detects the file change and reloads the bundle):

```powershell
  pnpm build
  Copy-Item .\client.js $env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\desktop\node_modules\dsh-model-picker\client.js -Force
  ```

- Unit tests: `pnpm test` (`node --test`, covers the pure logic in `src/pure.js`).
- Build check: `pnpm check` (`node --check` on artifacts). **CI fails if the
  committed `client.js` is stale** — always build after editing `src/`.
- For source edits to take effect instantly (no copying), install with a `link:`
  symlink instead.
- To remove the plugin: uninstall `dsh-model-picker` under DSH Settings → Plugins.
